Welcome Home to Serene Ranch Living! Escape to this charming 4-bedroom, 2-bathroom ranch-style retreat where city convenience meets country tranquility. Situated on a spacious one-acre lot just minutes from town, this property offers a great blend of urban accessibility and rural freedom—ideal for horse enthusiasts and small cattle owners alike. Step inside to discover a warm and inviting interior, featuring a cozy fireplace perfect for chilly evenings and a dining area spacious enough for family gatherings. The kitchen boasts gleaming stainless steel appliances, making meal preparation a delight. Highlights of this home include a generous primary bedroom with an adjacent bath featuring a nice garden tub, a spacious separate shower, dual walk-in closets, and double vanities. Three additional bedrooms provide ample space for family or guests, conveniently located near the hall bath with its own double vanities. Outside, entertain effortlessly on your covered porch, ideal for family BBQs, or gather around the firepit in the gravel area for starlit nights and s'mores under the open sky. Don't miss the opportunity to make this versatile property your own—where the possibilities are endless and every day feels like a retreat. Schedule your showing today and experience the best of both worlds!
